Darley — Derby, United Kingdom

Higher caution advised day Average night

In detail

Derbyshire Constabulary recorded 653 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 14.3 per 1,000 residents, the 4th highest rate of Derby's 17 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (27), drugs (13), vehicle crime (9); the evening/night score by violent crime (78), anti social behaviour (23), public order (23). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Darley safe?

Wandroz currently rates Darley in Derby as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Derby during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Derby at night. This rating is derived from Derbyshire Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Darley safe at night?

At night, Darley is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Derby. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Darley a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Darley's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Derby) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.
